overview: Dev Ambre, a ruthless cop, loses his memory in an accident just after he has finished solving a murder case and now has to reinvestigate it while keeping his memory loss a secret from everyone except DCP Farhan Khan.
title: Deva

results.title: Perfect Strangers
results.overview: A dinner party unravels when a tight group of friends agree to leave their phones unlocked on the table, exposing juicy interactions and dark secrets.

results.title: Om Shanti Om
results.overview: In the early 70s, aspiring actor Om Prakash Makhija, and a famous starlet Shantipriya, are murdered. Thirty years later, his reincarnation Om Kapoor sets out to discover the mystery of their demise.

results.title: The Twelve Jurors
results.overview: Did an 18-year-old immigrant from the slums murder his father in cold blood? The twelve jurors must find a unanimous verdict.

results.title: Bombay In The Night's Embrace
results.overview: A news reporter becomes a suspect after a robbery and a homicide aboard an aircraft.

results.title: Andolan
results.overview: Adarsh (Sanjay Dutt) and Aniket (Govinda) are brothers. Aniket is the elder, while Adarsh is the younger one. Both go to the same college, where beautiful Guddi (Mamta Kulkarni) has a crush on him, and vice-versa. Meanwhile, Adarsh is up to college pranks and practical jokes. One of these pranks and jokes land him into trouble in a girls only hostel. When the time comes to leave college and seek a career, both brothers chose a different path, one of which leads to the destruction and separation of their family.  Will they reunite in the end?

results.title: Fun with Dick and Jane
results.overview: After Dick Harper loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, Jane, turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, Dick and Jane actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it – but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people. When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister actually swindled the company, they plot revenge.

results.title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
results.original_title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
results.overview: In New York, armed men hijack a subway car and demand a ransom for the passengers while the authorities question about the method of their escape.

results.title: Mission Grey House
results.overview: Mission Grey House is a suspense thriller. A boy wants to become a police officer by any means, and to suffice his hunger he wears a police uniform on his own and starts fighting with goons and all. Knowing this Kiara's father who is an IG, asks about Kabir and he warns him about the consequences. She pleads his father to help Kabir to become an officer and she assures him that he will do his job with great responsibility, IG calls him and says 'main tumhe ek mission de raha hoon- Grey House. Tumhe ye pata karna hai yahan murder kyun ho rahe hain aur kaun kar raha hai, agar tumne ye pata kar liya to tumhara sapna main poora karunga and Kabir accepts. He goes to Grey House and gets trapped there. How he comes out of this? And how he finds the killer? How he saves his life? To know all of this you have to join us in the theatres and enjoy the film "Mission Grey House" with us.

results.title: The Hitcher
results.overview: While driving through the New Mexico Desert during a rainy night, college students Jim Halsey and his girlfriend Grace Andrews give a ride to a hitchhiker. While in their car, the stranger proves to be a psychopath threatening the young couple with a knife, but Jim successfully throws him out of the car. This sets off a chain of events that will change all of their lives forever.

results.title: Day of the Dead
results.overview: As the world is overrun by zombies, scientists and military personnel in an underground Florida bunker must decide on how they should deal with the undead.

results.title: Brothers
results.overview: When his helicopter goes down during his fourth tour of duty in Afghanistan, Marine Sam Cahill is presumed dead. Back home, brother Tommy steps in to look over Sam’s wife, Grace, and two children. Sam’s surprise homecoming triggers domestic mayhem.

results.title: Ishq
results.overview: A young couple, are mentally and physically harassed by two men while on a road trip. However, the situation puts their love to the test, making them go their separate ways.

results.title: The Truth About Charlie
results.overview: Regina meets charming Joshua while vacationing in Martinique, as she contemplates ending her whirlwind marriage to enigmatic Charlie. Upon her return to Paris, she finds that both her apartment and her bank account have been emptied, and her husband has been murdered. Stuck in ever-increasing danger and with four men pursuing her, another stranger offers assistance - but who can she trust?

results.title: Mirrors
results.overview: An ex-cop and his family are the target of an evil force that is using mirrors as a gateway into their home.

results.title: Lahoo Ke Do Rang
results.overview: Lahoo Ke Do Rang is about customs officer Bharat Srivastav who lives a middle-class life with his sister Rajni, wife Sangita and a small son. Rajni is soon to get married to Inspector Gautam. He is known for his unorthodox methods of apprehending smugglers, and it is these methods that land him in trouble with the Shikari brothers. Bharat decides to oppose them, and as a result the Shikari brothers recruit false eye-witnesses, pay them to give false testimonies and get the complaint dismissed. When Bharat persists, his family is abducted and subsequently killed. Bharat manages to kill some of the culprits, however, is arrested, found guilty and sentenced to life imprisonment. On the way to prison, the vehicle meets with an accident, killing everyone on board. Relieved at the death of their nemesis, the Shikari brothers celebrate only to find out that they now have a new unknown enemy, an enemy who will kill them one by one for an unknown reason.

results.title: Muqabla
results.overview: Govinda and Aditya Pancholi star in this powerful tale about two brothers whose love for each is greater than any other bond. While manipulative orphan Karisma (Karisma Kapoor) falls for Suraj (Govinda) and tricks him into marrying her, his sibling, Deepak (Pancholi), is busy with a love of his own. In the meantime, scheming underworld kingpin Khanna (Shakti Kapoor) is doing his best to tear Suraj and Deepak apart.

results.title: Sukiyaki Western Django
results.overview: A nameless gunfighter arrives in a town ripped apart by rival gangs and, though courted by both to join, chooses his own path.

results.title: Gone in Sixty Seconds
results.overview: Ex-car thief Randall Raines is forced out of retirement to save his brother Kip after a boost gone wrong. With the help of allies old and new, they race to meet the demands of notorious crime boss Raymond Calitri as the police are in hot pursuit.

results.title: Pulse
results.overview: When the dead discover a means to contact the living through electronic devices, cellphones and computers become open gateways to monstrosities and destruction.
